fields.summary_ko.0: SanDisk (SNDK) declined 30% early in the week then rebounded 4.4% on Friday, ranking fifth globally by NAND flash memory production volume.
fields.summary_ko.1: Citigroup expects supply shortages to persist as demand growth of 26% in 2027 outpaces Citigroup's projected production volume increase of 22%, with the company currently trading below 4x forward 2027 expected earnings.
